scenes.line2: What goes wrong if you skip them?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why Kubernetes pods need probes? What happens if you get them wrong?
There are two main probes. Liveness restarts containers if they hang. Readiness holds off traffic until your app is ready to serve.

scenes.label: Startup
scenes.sub: Gives slow apps time before liveness starts
scenes.say: For slow-starting apps, use a startup probe. It delays liveness checks until your app is really ready.

scenes.title: Pod probe config
scenes.say: Here's a sample pod spec. Liveness checks the health endpoint after ten seconds. Readiness checks if the app is ready to serve.

scenes.question: What if readiness and liveness are wrong?
scenes.wrong: The pod just runs fine anyway.
scenes.right: You risk restart loops and outages.
scenes.say: Watch out. If you set these probes wrong, you can trigger restart loops or even take your app offline.
